EIA Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (EBA) bulk file, no key, fetched 2026-09-23; EBA.{BA}-ALL.DF.H against EBA.{BA}-ALL.D.H over the 2025 hours both cover. Errors are absolute
and scope-corrected, so a grid forecasting a different quantity is not penalised twice. Circle area is mean demand. CAVEAT: percentile errors on grids under 1 GW are moved by
single hours; the 14 EIA region aggregates are excluded.
